title: Live
description: The gameweek in play (LIVE-04, DL-99): the latest gameweek past its deadline, from its first kick-off until the next deadline moves the live tables on. Its status, its matchdays and fixtures, and for the owner and each mini-league rival their provisional points from the one realised scorer (ORC-04), live total and rank among the published teams. **Provisional, and says so**: until FPL data-checks the gameweek the figures can move; `log.json` and the evaluation are the record, and nothing reads this file back (DP-14). Absent preseason and between a deadline and that gameweek's first kick-off, never empty (DP-15). From contract minor 8.

status.description: How far a gameweek, or one team's part of it, has got (LIVE-03): `in_play` a fixture still to finish; `bonus_pending` every fixture at full time, a bonus not yet confirmed (bonus is never estimated from BPS); `complete` every bonus confirmed, not yet data-checked; `final` FPL has data-checked it.

provisional.description: True until FPL data-checks the gameweek (`status` is `final`): every figure here can still move.

as_of.description: UTC instant of the run's snapshot (ORC-03).

observed_at.description: UTC instant the live scores were captured; null when none were read, and then no team has a live figure.

matchdays.description: The gameweek's matchdays in date order, done and to come (LIVE-02).

fixtures.description: The gameweek's fixtures in kick-off order. A postponed fixture has left the gameweek and is not here.

teams.description: The owner and every team in the mini-league table, ranked by live total first; teams without a live figure follow, by entry id.

live_matchday.description: The gameweek's fixtures that share a kick-off date in the configured matchday zone (UK time, R1.4.3 §5 Q1).

date.description: The kick-off date in the matchday zone.

fixtures_confirmed.description: Fixtures finished with their bonus confirmed.

done.description: Every fixture's bonus confirmed, or the settle cap passed since the last kick-off.

bonus_pending.description: Done by the settle cap with a bonus still unconfirmed: its points are without that bonus.

matchday.description: The `date` of the matchday it belongs to.

state.description: FPL's flags: not started; started; full time (minutes final, bonus not yet confirmed); finished with bonus confirmed.

live_team.description: One team's gameweek in play. A team whose picks, FPL figures or live scores were not read has `live: null` and a `reason`; that team alone degrades (NFR-15).

player_name.description: The manager's display name from the league table; null for an owner outside the league.

rank.description: Rank by live total among the published teams with one; equal totals share a rank. Null without a live figure.

reason.description: Why `live` is null; null when it is not.

matches_game.description: Once the gameweek is finished and FPL's figures are final: whether the scorer's gameweek points equal FPL's, both net of the hit (LIVE-03's check, a warning gate, R1.4.3 §5 Q3). Null until then, or without a live figure.

live_figures.description: The team's provisional gameweek, from the one realised scorer (ORC-04).

points.description: Provisional gameweek points, net of the hit.

hit_cost.description: This gameweek's hit, as FPL reports it, taken once.

chip.description: The chip played this gameweek, by the API's own name. Null when none.

chip_label.description: The chip's name as the game shows it. Null when none.

last_total.description: The season total after the last finished gameweek.

status.description: The team's own status, on the gameweek's rule, over the fixtures its fifteen have (LIVE-03).

captain_id.description: The player the armband counts for: the captain, or the vice-captain once the captain's gameweek is over without a minute.

autosubs_in.description: Projected substitutes coming on: only for a starter whose gameweek is over without a minute.

slot.description: As submitted: 1-11 start, 12-15 bench in order.

points.description: His gameweek so far, every fixture summed, bonus included as FPL has it.

bonus.description: FPL's bonus so far; never estimated from BPS.

bonus_confirmed.description: Every fixture he has has its bonus confirmed (true for a player with none).

complete.description: Every fixture he has is at full time: his minutes are final. False for a player yet to play.

multiplier.description: As applied: 0 off the field, 1 on it, the armband's multiplier on `captain_id`.

live_game.description: FPL's own figures for the team, from its picks. Before the gameweek is data-checked they are the deadline's capture, so they are not the gameweek's points (`final` false).

points.description: The gameweek's points before the hit, as FPL showed them.

total.description: The season total, this gameweek included.

final.description: Captured once FPL had data-checked the gameweek.
